name: ons.GestureDetector
description:
[en]Utility class for gesture detection.[/en]
[ja]ジェスチャを検知するためのユーティリティクラスです。[/ja]

properties.name: defaults
properties.description:
default settings.
more settings are defined per gesture at `/gestures`. Each gesture can be disabled/enabled
by setting it's name (like `swipe`) to false.
You can set the defaults for all instances by changing this object before creating an instance.

properties.name: DOCUMENT
properties.description: GestureDetector document where the base events are added at

properties.name: HAS_POINTEREVENTS
properties.description: detect support for pointer events

properties.name: HAS_TOUCHEVENTS
properties.description: detect support for touch events

properties.name: IS_MOBILE
properties.description: detect mobile browsers

properties.name: NO_MOUSEEVENTS
properties.description: detect if we want to support mouseevents at all

properties.name: CALCULATE_INTERVAL
properties.description: interval in which GestureDetector recalculates current velocity/direction/angle in ms

properties.name: EVENT_TYPES
properties.description:
eventtypes per touchevent (start, move, end) are filled by `Event.determineEventTypes` on `setup`
the object contains the DOM event names per type (`EVENT_START`, `EVENT_MOVE`, `EVENT_END`)

properties.name: DIRECTION_DOWN|LEFT|UP|RIGHT
properties.description: direction strings, for safe comparisons

properties.name: POINTER_MOUSE|TOUCH|PEN
properties.description: pointertype strings, for safe comparisons

properties.name: EVENT_START|MOVE|END|RELEASE|TOUCH
properties.description: eventtypes

properties.name: READY
properties.description: if the window events are set...

properties.name: plugins
properties.description: plugins namespace

properties.name: gestures
properties.description:
gestures namespace
see `/gestures` for the definitions

properties.name: prevent_mouseevents
properties.description:
when touch events have been fired, this is true
this is used to stop mouse events

properties.name: started
properties.description: if EVENT_START has been fired

properties.name: should_detect
properties.description: when the mouse is hold down, this is true

properties.name: pointers
properties.description: holds all pointers, by `identifier`

properties.name: options
properties.description:
options, merged with the defaults
options with an _ are converted to camelCase

properties.name: eventStartHandler
properties.description: event start handler on the element to start the detection

properties.name: eventHandlers
properties.description: keep a list of user event handlers which needs to be removed when calling 'dispose'

properties.name: dragMinDistance
properties.description: minimal movement that have to be made before the drag event gets triggered

properties.name: dragDistanceCorrection
properties.description:
Set dragDistanceCorrection to true to make the starting point of the drag
be calculated from where the drag was triggered, not from where the touch started.
Useful to avoid a jerk-starting drag, which can make fine-adjustments
through dragging difficult, and be visually unappealing.

properties.name: dragMaxTouches
properties.description: set 0 for unlimited, but this can conflict with transform

properties.name: dragBlockHorizontal
properties.description:
prevent default browser behavior when dragging occurs
be careful with it, it makes the element a blocking element
when you are using the drag gesture, it is a good practice to set this true

properties.name: dragBlockVertical
properties.description: same as `dragBlockHorizontal`, but for vertical movement

properties.name: dragLockToAxis
properties.description:
dragLockToAxis keeps the drag gesture on the axis that it started on,
It disallows vertical directions if the initial direction was horizontal, and vice versa.

properties.name: dragLockMinDistance
properties.description:
drag lock only kicks in when distance > dragLockMinDistance
This way, locking occurs only when the distance has become large enough to reliably determine the direction

properties.name: holdThreshold
properties.description: movement allowed while holding

properties.name: swipeVelocityX
properties.description: horizontal swipe velocity

properties.name: swipeVelocityY
properties.description: vertical swipe velocity

properties.name: tapMaxTime
properties.description: max time of a tap, this is for the slow tappers

properties.name: tapMaxDistance
properties.description: max distance of movement of a tap, this is for the slow tappers

properties.name: tapAlways
properties.description: always trigger the `tap` event, even while double-tapping

properties.name: doubleTapDistance
properties.description: max distance between two taps

properties.name: doubleTapInterval
properties.description: max time between two taps

properties.name: preventDefault
properties.description:
call preventDefault at touchstart, and makes the element blocking by disabling the scrolling of the page,
but it improves gestures like transforming and dragging.
be careful with using this, it can be very annoying for users to be stuck on the page

properties.name: preventMouse
properties.description: disable mouse events, so only touch (or pen!) input triggers events

properties.name: transformMinScale
properties.description: minimal scale factor, no scale is 1, zoomin is to 0 and zoomout until higher then 1

properties.name: transformMinRotation
properties.description: rotation in degrees

params.name: element
params.description:
[en]Name of the event.[/en]
   [ja]ジェスチャを検知するDOM要素を指定します。[/ja]

params.description:

   [ja]オプションを指定します。[/ja]

methods.name: on

params.name: gestures
params.description:
[en]A space separated list of gestures.[/en]
   [ja]検知するジェスチャ名を指定します。スペースで複数指定することができます。[/ja]

params.name: handler
params.description:
[en]An event handling function.[/en]
   [ja]イベントハンドラとなる関数オブジェクトを指定します。[/ja]

methods.description:
[en]Adds an event handler for a gesture. Available gestures are: drag, dragleft, dragright, dragup, dragdown, hold, release, swipe, swipeleft, swiperight, swipeup, swipedown, tap, doubletap, touch, transform, pinch, pinchin, pinchout and rotate. [/en]
[ja]ジェスチャに対するイベントハンドラを追加します。指定できるジェスチャ名は、drag dragleft dragright dragup dragdown hold release swipe swipeleft swiperight swipeup swipedown tap doubletap touch transform pinch pinchin pinchout rotate です。[/ja]

methods.name: off

params.name: gestures
params.description:
[en]A space separated list of gestures.[/en]
   [ja]ジェスチャ名を指定します。スペースで複数指定することができます。[/ja]

params.name: handler
params.description:
[en]An event handling function.[/en]
   [ja]イベントハンドラとなる関数オブジェクトを指定します。[/ja]

methods.name: enable

params.name: state
params.description:
[en]Specify if it should be enabled or not.[/en]
   [ja]有効にするかどうかを指定します。[/ja]

methods.description:
[en]Enable or disable gesture detection.[/en]
[ja]ジェスチャ検知を有効化/無効化します。[/ja]

methods.name: dispose
methods.description:
[en]Remove and destroy all event handlers for this instance.[/en]
[ja]このインスタンスでのジェスチャの検知や、イベントハンドラを全て解除して廃棄します。[/ja]
